item.text:
**4B.1 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**

**Bottom line:** mixed but leaning negative. AMLO accepted the 2024 transfer procedurally, but the stronger record in 2024 is that he kept attacking the independent election authority and pushed reforms that critics said would weaken electoral contestability and concentrate power.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Presentan resultados de elecciones en conferencia del presidente; se requiere garantizar el derecho a la información, afirma | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-05 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presentan-resultados-de-elecciones-en-conferencia-del-presidente-se-requiere-garantizar-el-derecho-a-la-informacion-afirma/ | AMLO publicly presented the INE’s preliminary presidential results and framed the moment as guaranteeing public access to information, which is consistent with accepting the election outcome rather than rejecting it. | 4B.1 |
| Tribunal Electoral valida elección presidencial: Segob; presidente celebra ejemplar transición en gobierno federal | Presidencia de México | 2024-08-13 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/tribunal-electoral-valida-eleccion-presidencial-segob-presidente-celebra-ejemplar-transicion-en-gobierno-federal/ | After the electoral tribunal validated the presidential election, AMLO’s government publicly celebrated an “ejemplar transición,” which is direct evidence of procedural acceptance of the transfer of power. | 4B.1 |
| 20.06.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador | Presidencia de México | 2024-06-20 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/ | AMLO said a vote-by-vote recount is the best way to remove suspicion and stated that one should respect what the electoral authority decides, which supports a limited pro-process, pro-contestability reading. | 4B.1 |
| México pasa reforma electoral que críticos dicen debilita la democracia | Reuters via Investing.com | 2022-12-15 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexicos-senate-approves-electoral-reform-bill-3011421 | Reuters reported that AMLO repeatedly attacked the INE, said voter fraud robbed him in 2006, and backed cuts to the electoral authority’s budget, staffing, and offices, which critics said threatened reliable elections. | 4B.1 |
| Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with super-majority in sight | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906 | Reuters reported AMLO’s 2024 reform push would overhaul the INE and that critics saw it as a way to cement Morena’s political hegemony and lower the bar for referendums, which cuts against genuine acceptance of contestable power. | 4B.1 |
| Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with super-majority in sight | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906 | Reuters said AMLO frequently lambasted the INE and sought to completely overhaul it; that is strong evidence against wholehearted acceptance of free and fair electoral contestation as a constraint on power. | 4B.1 |

**Search gap:** I did not find a clean, direct 2024 quote from AMLO saying he endorsed losing power in a free and fair election as a principle. The strongest positive evidence is procedural: he presented the results, respected the tribunal’s validation, and accepted transition. The strongest negative evidence is institutional: repeated attacks on the INE and a reform agenda critics said would weaken electoral independence.
